page.overview:
What is The Ministry?

The Ministry is one of the 13 clans of Vampire: The Masquerade 5th Edition. They are a clan of priests, pedlars and pushers. They use temptation as a weapon and organize themselves in a cult-like clan fashion, determined to shatter the shibboleths and dogma of mainstream ideologies.

Since many clan elders believed their founder was the Egyptian god Set, the clan was formerly known as the Followers of Set. For most of their history, they were inextricably linked to this controlling faction, the Church of Set, and remained thorough independent of the sects. Since the start of the Gehenna War, however, the majority of the clan has broken from its elders and joined the Anarchs.

Tracing its origins to Set – the Egyptian god of darkness and desert storms, lies and chaos – the clan formerly known as the Followers of Set has a reputation as varied as its history. Part cult and part clan, the Ministry promotes its uniquely subversive ideology as it fights a war against the ontological hegemony of Ra and the demiurge. Known and abhorred as tricksters, enticers, and outright liars, the clan has had a history of playing all sides in the conflicts of the sects and clans. After their request to join the Camarilla was rebuffed, many have joined the Anarch Movement and are now arming their twin weapons of ingratiation, temptation and disruption to free all the Children of Caine.

is a lie. Set-Apep, Loki, Kali, Lucifer, Ahura Mazda. Satan. No matter their name, they are the eternal enemy of the divine. They are the noble devil, seeking to liberate man- kind from the tyranny of God. In this tale he is Set, and it is he, not Caine who is first among the hungry dead. This is a true lie that most Serpents believe. In their own minds they are not cursed by God, but the blessed children of a slumbering Anti-God.}}
